messages:
arya: We need a focused 45m meeting to finalize the security/privacy checklist for the upcoming audit. Primary goals: confirm service-account inventory, identify escalation paths, agree on remediation owners, and list required artifacts for the audit packet.

arya: Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 09:30-10:15
- Thu 14:00-14:45

arya: Draft agenda (editable):
```
1) Roll call & quick status (5m) - who has full IAM/export
2) Walk thru service-account inventory focusing on high-privilege ones (15m)
3) Privilege escalation scenarios & mitigations (10m)
4) Secrets rotation + KMS access checklist (5m)
5) Audit artifacts list & owner assignment (8m)
6) Confirm action items & deadlines (2m)
```

mike: Wed 09:30 is my preferred. I'll bring the IAM export and last 7 days auth logs. I'll also paste a small table of anomalous auths.

samir: I can do Wed. Note: a few service-accounts in eu-west are missing from the central sheet (legacy infra). I'll reconcile and flag them.

jess: Need to include a short note about k8s projected tokens + vault rotation gaps. Can we add that into item 4 (+3m)? I'll prepare one slide.

olivia: Also add a GDPR/data-residency check for any SA that touches user PII. I can draft the artifact blurb for the packet.

arya: Ok folding jess & olivia asks into agenda. We'll keep 45m total.

sec-bot: Reminder: propose a time and add calendar once confirmed. Link template: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/SEC-REVIEW

mike: I'll do Wed 09:30. Attaching preliminary IAM export here before the meeting.

samir: Uploading inventory v2 -> https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/f/service-account-inventory-v2.xlsx. Marked legacy eu-west accounts with NOTE column.

jess: Slide uploaded (rotation-gaps.pdf). Short bullets + proposed rotation cadence.

olivia: GDPR blurb added to the drive doc under 'audit artifacts' section.

arya: Finalizing: meeting locked for Wed 09:30-10:15 PT. Pre-meeting deliverables (due Tue EOD):
- samir: updated inventory + notes on eu-west legacy SAs
- mike: IAM export + auth log snippets
- jess: 1-slide rotation gap summary (PDF)
- olivia: GDPR/data-residency artifact wording
- arya: meeting notes template + initial list of threat scenarios

arya: I'll create the invite and attach the drive link. If someone can't make it, please ping here and propose an alternative.

mike: heads up I'll include a tiny table of failed auth attempts by service — could be helpful for escalation discussion.

samir: done: spreadsheet link + short comments in the NOTE column. Will follow up with a quick summary in the thread before Wed.

arya: Thanks team. See you Wed. :wave:
